title: GateHouse / benchmark targets
subtitle: A small gateway with a measurable resource envelope and useful failure insight.
notes: Planning targets, not a leaderboard. Shading highlights the goal row; it does not rank performance.
REF = eligible Caddy / Traefik: fastest sustainable capacity or lower peak RSS, at matched feature settings.
HTTP P0 first; HTTP/2 + gRPC after M4. Separate protocols / workloads; no unsupported feature gets a zero.
Report whole-stack cost including control plane + PostgreSQL (T08); lower proxy RSS is not total deployment savings.
All values await controlled measurement. Definitions and evidence rules: docs/Gatehouse_PRODUCT_BENCHMARKS.md.
